items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: "Glenn Miller did one of the things. And they called me -- I think Shapiro-Bernstein had the song. And they called me up -- they thought it mine ... I say, 'No, that's not mine. You mean the other tenor player, Joe Thomas,'"

ctx.x: You studied medicine. Tell us a little about that. Where did you study?

Yes. When I was working in the drug store with Dr. Miller, he thought that I could have -- he was interested in me going into medicine. "Come on, why don't you be a doctor? What you wanna mess with music for?" I said, "Well, you know, I don't think my mother has that kind of money. It takes a lot of money to be a doctor." He said, "Oh no." He had a position
